marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Game movie is a story of 4 strangers (Neil Menon, OP Ramsay, Tisha Khanna, and Vikram Kapoor) who have been invited by the reclusive Kabir Malhotra, to the private island of Samos, Greece. They don't know each other and they don't know him and by the next morning they will wish they had never come. It is a whodunit with twists and turns through revenge, retribution, prostitution, drug empires and good old-fashioned murder. Spanning 5 international cities, it is a slick, edge-of-the-seat crime thriller, where every 10-odd minutes sees a new twists that propels the story in an entirely unforeseen direction. Everyone is a suspect, and every suspect has a movie. It's not over until it's over.
